definitions.gloss: first half; first half of a fiscal year; first half of a business period
definitions.explanation: The first half of a fiscal year or accounting period. In Japan, where the fiscal year typically runs April to March, the first half is April to September.

examples.japanese: {上期|かみき}の{売上|うりあげ}。
{上期|かみき}の{業績|ぎょうせき}は{好調|こうちょう}だった。
{上期|かみき}{決算|けっさん}の{結果|けっか}を{受|う}けて、{通期|つうき}の{見通|みとお}しを{上方|じょうほう}{修正|しゅうせい}した。
examples.english: Based on the first-half earnings results, the full-year outlook was revised upward.

notes: A business term. In Japan, most companies and the government use a fiscal year running from April to March, so {上期|かみき} is April–September. Also read as じょうき in some contexts. Common collocations: {上期|かみき}{決算|けっさん} (first-half earnings), {上期|かみき}{業績|ぎょうせき} (first-half results). The opposite is {下期|しもき} (second half of the fiscal year, October–March). Related: {通期|つうき} (full year), {四半期|しはんき} (quarter).
